$comment: Single source of truth for store-side custom data. Used by scripts/store-setup.ts (Admin GraphQL via `shopify store execute`) and by the local emulator in dev/. Keys and types here must match what the theme reads.

metaobjects.name: Flavour story
metaobjects.description: The story, facts and 3D settings for one flavour. Linked from each product's 'Flavour story' field. Any blank field hides itself on the site.

fields.name: Name on the tag
fields.description: Short name handwritten on the jar tag, e.g. Nutella Chunk. Blank uses the product title.

fields.name: Memory
fields.description: The one specific memory this flavour tastes like. One or two lines.

fields.name: Best with
fields.description: Reads on its own, e.g. 'Best with evening chai'.

fields.name: Flavour colour
fields.description: The main ingredient's colour. Used for the jar lid and accents.

fields.name: Second colour
fields.description: Optional, e.g. pistachio green for Rose Gulkand.

fields.name: Aroma burst
fields.description: What rises out of the jar when it opens.

fields.name: Cookie shape (3D)
fields.description: Which 3D cookie the jar is filled with. A new flavour can reuse any shape.

fields.name: Allergens
fields.description: One per line, e.g. Wheat (gluten), Milk, Tree nuts (pistachio). Blank hides the allergen line.

fields.name: Eggless
fields.description: Leave unset if unsure; unset hides the eggless mark.

fields.name: Shelf life
fields.description: e.g. 'Best within 10 days of baking'. Blank hides it.

fields.name: Local name note
fields.description: Glosses a less-known word once, e.g. 'omam, that's ajwain'.

fields.name: Texture close-ups
fields.description: Real macro photos. Blank uses the product's own photos.

fields.name: Share image
fields.description: Image used when this flavour is shared on WhatsApp/Instagram. Blank uses the product photo.

metaobjects.name: Today's trays
metaobjects.description: Update every morning from the Shopify app (Content > Metaobjects). The board on the site only shows when the date is today (India time).

fields.name: Date
fields.description: The day these trays are for. The board hides itself on any other day.

metafields.name: Flavour story
metafields.description: Links this product to its flavour story.
